findings.summary: The diff edits a test file already on main (one name added to test_public_api's exact __all__ set), against spec R14 and the intent's constraint that no existing test file is edited; this is a feature change, so the fix-type framework rule does not apply. R1/Acceptance require the export, so the conflict is real, and plan.md records the departure in the same commit (91dff56). Graded a nit because the edit weakens nothing, but the owner should confirm the choice.
